Let's break down the question into simpler subquestions:

1. What years did Tony Ricciardello drive an Alfa Romeo Alfetta GTV-Chevrolet vehicle in the National Sports Sedan Series?
2. In which of those years was Tony Ricciardello the champion?

The answer to the original question can be derived from the insights provided:

<answer>
Tony Ricciardello was the champion in the years 1998 and 2001 when he drove an Alfa Romeo Alfetta GTV-Chevrolet vehicle in the National Sports Sedan Series.
</answer>
